about.heading:
Daily planning that
feels like a ritual
about.intro: You should never have to choose between a serious 12-month schedule and a book you actually love opening on your desk.

manifesto.heading:
Heavy cream paper.
Monthly potion shelves.
paragraphs: Every January starts with the same disappointment: standard big-box planners use thin 70 gsm white paper that ghosts with gel pens and sterile grey boxes that make your life feel like office paperwork.

Merrivy starts there, with a dated 2027 hardcover grimoire printed on 120 gsm vintage cream paper—complete with 12 laminated monthly tabs, potion-bottle habit trackers, Read / Watch / Listen logs, a snap-in bookmark ruler, and 4 gothic sticker sheets.

principles.label: 01 / The paper
principles.title: Start with 120 gsm vintage cream stock.
principles.text: A planner should welcome your favorite gel pens, fineliners, and mild highlighters without bleeding into next week.

principles.label: 02 / The rituals
principles.title: Make daily habits visual.
principles.text: Color in a numbered apothecary potion bottle each night and track every book, show, and album at the start of every month.

principles.label: 03 / The promise
principles.title: Flip through it at home, or it goes back.
principles.text: 30 days from delivery to inspect the hardcover, foil, tabs, and paper on your own desk.
